title: Sheaf of modules associated to a module over the global sections
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism] and $R=\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$; for an open $U\subseteq X$ regard $\mathcal O_X(U)$ as an $R$-algebra through the restriction map $R=\mathcal O_X(X)\to\mathcal O_X(U)$. For an $R$-module $M$ let $\mathcal P_M$ be the presheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] with $\mathcal P_M(U)=\mathcal O_X(U)\otimes_RM$ (the base change of $M$ to $\mathcal O_X(U)$ [def-weil-module-base-change], an $\mathcal O_X(U)$-module through the factor $\mathcal O_X(U)$) and restriction maps $\rho^U_V\otimes\mathrm{id}_M$ for $V\subseteq U$. The *sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules associated to $M$* is the sheafification $\mathcal F_M=\mathcal P_M^\#$ [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with its $\mathcal O_X$-linear sheafification map $\sigma_M:\mathcal P_M\to\mathcal F_M$; its *canonical section map* is the $R$-linear map $c_M:M\to\Gamma(X,\mathcal F_M)$, $c_M(m)=\sigma_{M,X}(1\otimes m)$. For an $R$-linear map $u:M\to M'$, the maps $\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal O_X(U)}\otimes u$ form a morphism $\mathcal P_u:\mathcal P_M\to\mathcal P_{M'}$ of presheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, and $\mathcal F_u:\mathcal F_M\to\mathcal F_{M'}$ is the unique $\mathcal O_X$-linear map with $\mathcal F_u\circ\sigma_M=\sigma_{M'}\circ\mathcal P_u$ (universal property of sheafification); in particular $\mathcal F_{u,X}\circ c_M=c_{M'}\circ u$. This makes $M\mapsto\mathcal F_M$ a functor from $R$-modules to $\mathcal O_X$-modules. (Stacks, Modules, Lemma 01BH, construction (3), with $\alpha=\mathrm{id}_R$, and Definition 01BI.)
